text.p: September notionnel futures traded on MATIF look negative on Monday but a break below 128.94 is needed to confirm that, technical anlaysts said.

"Notionnel is still consolidating in a 128.94 to 129.56 intraday range," said Raynard Cheng, techncial analyst at First Chicago in London. "The risk is to the downside. If it goes below 128.94, that will open the way to further losses."
On the daily chart that level was a low on June 25 and is also the low so far this session.
At 0820 GMT, September notionnel futures were at 129.42, up eight basis points on the day.
Cheng said the Fibonacci support came in at 128.82, a 50 percent retracement of the rally from 126.40 on June 2 to the 131.24 contract high formed on July 23.
If that level was broken, he said, a further support was available at 128.42, a 61.8 percent retracement of the same rally.
Jim Dodgin, senior technical analyst at Technical Data in London, also said 129.94 was a key level for notionnel.
"If we go down significantly below there then this market is really looking in trouble with 128.42, the late June low, the next level."
Beyond there the contract would head for 127.50 and then 126.40, he said.
To the upside, Dodgin said there was resistance around 129.50 to 129.56.

"If it can break above there, then notionnel starts to look in reasonable shape, but most of the studies are still on a downtrend so you would have to expect further tests of the support levels," he said.
At the short end, September Pibor futures were at 96.51, up 0.03 on the day.
